The user requested an immediate stop and PR delivery after eight completed diagnostics. Basis acquisition was terminated during crossover/simplex cleanup; nine remaining registered arms are explicitly NOT_RUN.

Measured results (Threads=4, unchanged tolerances; root LPs fresh and fully relaxed):

| Formulation | Method0 (600s) | Method1 (600s) | Method2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Original | TIME_LIMIT, 600.039s | TIME_LIMIT, 600.004s | OPTIMAL, 74.080s |

Terminal LP objectives reproduce the historical values within 2.158e-10. In 300s Method2 MIP confirmations, both exact PR126 Starts were accepted with zero primary-variable difference. Original completed root relaxation at 208.621s; Compact was still in crossover at cutoff. Neither showed branching. Method1 root-method sensitivity is CONFIRMED for Original and STRONGLY_SUPPORTED for Compact; these results do not establish a production solve or faster Compact branching.

Grid families contribute 84.794% / 55.394% of Original / Compact nonzeros. Exact duplicate counts, coefficient-source replay, conservative tiny-coefficient impact bounds and rational projection proofs are included. The algebraically exact injection projection increases nonzeros to 34,229,409; its optimization comparison was not run. No terminal optimal simplex basis was obtained, so degeneracy and basis conditioning remain INCONCLUSIVE. Scaling, auxiliary runtime/objective gates and physical-family isolation are unmeasured after the stop.

Preserve original preregistration, initial STOP and both explicitly approved amended freezes: cold/Start signed/unsigned fingerprint correction, and a deterministic row-scaling transport guard for 342 otherwise-deleted coefficients. Neither amendment changes the inherited source matrix. Historical wall-time comparisons are indicative; new heavy arms ran sequentially, independent jobs were allowed, and concurrent resource receipts are retained.

The inherited 2,536 files and valid UB=0.5912812634331275, LB=0.5722125039436496, gap=3.22498964% remain unchanged. M1_ACCEPTED=false; COMPACT_M1_PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED=false; production and all downstream stages NOT_RUN. All changes are restricted to v42_root_diagnostics/ and docs/v42_m1_root_pathology_diagnostics/.

Validation and Korean ordered review: docs/v42_m1_root_pathology_diagnostics/FINAL_REVIEW_KO.md, VERIFICATION.json, PYTEST_RECEIPT.json, STAGED_BYTE_AUDIT.json and SHA256_MANIFEST.json. Raw logs, live interrupted trace, USER_STOP_RECEIPT.json and explicit unrun receipts are preserved. No further diagnostic solve is authorized by this PR.
Full pytest: 912 passed, 1 inherited RuntimeWarning (log1p), 94.18s. git diff --check, all source/input freezes, 2,536 inherited physical files, 146 staged byte identities (including manifest/audit self-reference exclusions checked separately), JSON/log SHA and manifest audits PASS. Initial full-suite signed-zero mapping failure and its zero-numeric-difference resolution are preserved alongside the successful rerun.

Archived unified-diff context whitespace is preserved byte-for-byte under a diagnostic-only *.patch attribute; the complete diff against exact PR126 also passes.
